Title: Seller purchases 3-day or 7-day Bump with sufficient coins and boosts listing to top 3 search results
Preconditions: Seller has >= 60 coins in wallet and an Available listing in an eligible category.
Steps:
1. Open the listing page as the seller and tap 'Promote'.
2. Select '3-day Bump (30 coins)' and confirm purchase.
3. Check coin balance, listing page timer, and category search results as a buyer.
Expected Result: 30 coins are deducted immediately; listing page displays remaining promotion time; listing appears in top 3 search positions for its category with a 'Promoted' badge.

Title: Seller with insufficient coins is prompted to top up when attempting to promote
Preconditions: Seller has 20 coins in wallet and an Available listing.
Steps:
1. Tap 'Promote' on the listing.
2. Select '3-day Bump (30 coins)' or '7-day Bump (60 coins)'.
Expected Result: Purchase is blocked and seller is prompted to top up coins.

Title: Promotion eligibility restrictions for non-Available listings and restricted categories
Preconditions: Seller has a Reserved listing, a Sold listing, and an Available listing in a Trust & Safety restricted category.
Steps: 1. Navigate to each of the three listings as the seller and check the 'Promote' option.
Expected Result: Reserved, Sold, and restricted-category listings cannot be promoted.

Title: Promotion expiration removes 'Promoted' label, restores organic rank, and displays stats comparison
Preconditions: A listing has an active 3-day Bump that reaches expiration.
Steps:
1. Advance time past the 3-day promotion duration.
2. Check search results for the listing.
3. View the listing stats card on the seller's listing page.
Expected Result: 'Promoted' label is removed and listing returns to organic search ranking; seller sees stats card comparing views and chats during the 3-day promotion against the prior 3-day period.
